items.html: *AK contains AB, SAG, MA, BON, in its self. Each of these four incorporates all four, and lights emerge from it, which are its branches. The AB is in its Mochin, opposite AA and Abba of Atzilut. Above its Galgalta, it contains a model of Atik of Atzilut, and its SAG is from the Ozen down to its Tabur, opposite Bina of Atzilut, and its MA and BON are from its Tabur down, opposite ZON of Atzilut.
